payload.claim: The docstring sentence "So is `retired_first`." attaches, by normal English reading, to the immediately preceding predicate "is exactly the repo whose work was done by hand," which makes no sense applied to a field. The intended referent is the paragraph's earlier claim that `specs/done/` is read either way regardless of `repo_id`, but the intervening clause about SA-0020 breaks that link, so the sentence as written states something incoherent rather than the fact it means to add.
